(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS:  BHMCT   SEMESTER : VI
BRANCH: BHMCT   SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: MT123 BUSINESS COMMUNICATIONS
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) Define Communication. [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) Write the objectives of business communication. [3] 1 2


Q.2(a) Explain the process of communication. [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Write the steps to overcome the barriers to communication. [3] 1 2


Q.3(a) Differentiate between formal and informal communication. [2] 2 4
Q.3(b) What do you mean by non-verbal communication? [3] 2 1


Q.4(a) Define oculesics. [2] 2 1
Q.4(b) How is haptics used in communication? [3] 2 3


Q.5(a) Give meaning for a) Addition, Edition b) Biannual, Biennial [2] 3 2
Q.5(b) Give idiomic meaning for a) To add fuel to fire b) A bed of roses c) Speak one’s mind. [3] 3 2

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1 Communication means sharing of understanding between people.’ Explain the statement. [5] 1 2


Q.2 With  the  help  of  suitable  examples,  explain  the  various  communication  barriers.  As  a
manager, what measures would you use to overcome them?
[5] 1 2


Q.3 ‘Whether an organization is small or large, it is communication that binds the organization
together’. Discuss in brief the formal flow of communication in an organization in the light
of the above statement.
[5] 2 2


Q.4 ‘Like  Body  Language,  your  voice  carries  both  intentional  and  unintentional  messages’
Illustrate  the  various  aspects  of  voice  that  determine  the  success  of  any  speech  or
presentation.
[5] 4 4


Q.5 Effective listening is a rather daunting task. Substantiate your answers with appropriate
examples.
[5] 2 4
